name: telegram
description: Telegram connector — send messages, read updates, inspect chats via the Bot API

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Telegram
examples: Send me a Telegram message when the build finishes
What's the chat id for the person who just messaged my bot?

setup.title: Open @BotFather in Telegram
setup.detail: BotFather is Telegram's official bot for creating bots. Open it in the Telegram app (or Telegram Web).

setup.title: Create a new bot
setup.detail: Send /newbot to BotFather. Pick a display name, then a unique username that MUST end in `bot` (e.g. my_dimension_bot).

setup.title: Copy the HTTP API token
setup.detail: BotFather replies with a token like 123456789:ABCdefGhIJKlmNoPQRsTUVwxyz. Paste it into the form below — it stays on this machine.

setup.title: Say hello to your bot
setup.detail: A bot cannot message a user who never messaged it first. Open a chat with your new bot (or add it to a group) and send /start. Then run telegram_get_updates to discover the chat_id you can message.

form.label: Bot API Token
form.help: The HTTP API token @BotFather gives you when you create a bot with /newbot (or later via /mybots → API Token).

failures.title: Reconnect Telegram — the bot token is invalid
failures.detail: Ask @BotFather for the token again (/mybots → API Token) and paste the fresh value.

tools.name: telegram_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a Telegram chat via the bot. Destructive — confirm recipient and text first. Returns the sent message_id.

tools.name: telegram_get_updates
tools.description: Read recent incoming messages the bot received (chat id/title, sender, text). Use to discover a chat_id. Only works when no webhook is set.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat
tools.description: Look up a chat's title, type, username, and description by chat_id or @username.

tools.name: telegram_reply_message
tools.description: Reply to a specific message in a chat (threads under the original). Destructive — confirm chat_id, the message_id, and reply text first. Returns the sent message_id.

tools.name: telegram_edit_message
tools.description: Replace the text of a message the bot itself sent. Cannot edit other users' messages. Destructive — confirm chat_id, message_id, and new text first.

tools.name: telegram_delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message from a chat. Irreversible — demand explicit confirmation of chat_id and message_id. Bot's own any time; others' only within 48h and with admin rights.

tools.name: telegram_pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message to the top of a chat, or unpin it when unpin=true. Needs 'pin messages' admin rights in groups. Confirm chat_id, message_id, and pin/unpin first.

tools.name: telegram_send_photo
tools.description: Send a photo to a chat by https:// URL with an optional caption. Destructive — confirm recipient, photo URL, and caption first. Returns the sent message_id.
